verdict.rationale: Cursor's built-in Agent/Composer is extensively documented as delegating coding tasks — handing off implementation, testing, and demoing to an in-editor and cloud agent while the user reviews and decides (cursor-docs-11, cursor-docs-12, cursor-supp-cloud-agents). This is corroborated by probes confirming live docs and API surfaces. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation specifically of task-delegation quality (community evidence is mostly about unrelated bugs/pricing, not delegation itself).
